component.name: Corvo
component.summary: Клиент WhatsApp Web для рабочего стола

description.p: Corvo puts WhatsApp Web into a real desktop window instead of a browser tab: a system tray icon with an unread counter, desktop notifications, remembered window geometry and a session that is scanned once and then kept.

ul.li: Tray icon with an unread-message badge; closing the window hides it to the tray
Desktop notifications through org.freedesktop.Notifications, clicking one opens the chat
Voice and video calls, with camera and microphone permissions granted automatically
Built-in camera and microphone check, so a broken device is easy to tell from a broken permission
Interface follows the language WhatsApp itself uses; English, German, Ukrainian and Russian are included
Optional autostart, page zoom, spell checking
Only web.whatsapp.com is allowed to load; every other link opens in the system browser

description.p: Corvo is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc. It only displays the public web interface, and using that interface remains subject to WhatsApp's terms.

Corvo открывает WhatsApp Web в обычном окне рабочего стола, а не во вкладке браузера: значок в системном трее со счётчиком непрочитанных, уведомления рабочего стола, запомненная геометрия окна и сессия, которую нужно подтвердить QR-кодом только один раз.

Corvo — независимый проект, не связанный с WhatsApp LLC и Meta Platforms, Inc. и не одобренный ими. Программа лишь показывает публичный веб-интерфейс, использование которого подчиняется правилам WhatsApp.

screenshot.caption: Signing in by scanning the QR code once
Settings: language, tray behaviour, autostart, device check

ul.li: Generated desktop entries and the autostart file now point at the running binary, so they keep working wherever the application is installed
Autostart is disabled in Flatpak builds: inside a sandbox it belongs to the Background portal, which is not implemented yet
Documentation split into a user-facing README and developer notes

description.p: First public release under the name Corvo.

ul.li: Voice and video calls work: the engine now exposes SharedArrayBuffer and the Encoded Transform API that WhatsApp checks for
The interface follows the language WhatsApp renders in and switches without a restart
Tray icon with unread badge, desktop notifications, autostart, camera and microphone diagnostics
